The Outskill invitation at 12:19 was a **Google Calendar invitation addressed to your Yahoo email**. Calendar invitations (`.ics`/iCalendar data) can be recognized by Yahoo Mail/Calendar and appear in your calendar depending on Yahoo's calendar/invitation handling.

4. **Account compromise.**  
   Possible in principle, but **nothing you've shown establishes this**. Receiving a genuine Zoom registration confirmation only establishes that Zoom received a registration containing your email address.
